name: Standard Background Information & Re-Verification Report
description: Machine-readable versioned template modeled on the standard banking pre-sanction re-verification report format.

header.report_subtitle: Pre-Sanction Background Investigation & Document Re-Verification Dossier

particulars.title: Name and Address
particulars.description: Full legal name, father's name, present residential address, and permanent address.

particulars.title: Residence
particulars.description: Physical verification of residential premises, occupancy confirmation, and Aadhaar linkage.

particulars.title: Whether address of residence/unit is seen and confirmed through physical visit - Observations
particulars.description: Confirmation of physical visit with field observations on locality, living standard, and stability.

particulars.title: Name of official/person who visited - Date of visit
particulars.description: Name, employee code, and designation of visiting officer along with date and time of visit.

particulars.title: If no, reason for not physically visiting
particulars.description: Specific reason / exemption justification if physical site visit could not be performed.

particulars.title: Status of residence
particulars.description: Tenure status: Owned / Parental / Ancestral / Rented / Company Provided / Leased.

particulars.title: Aadhaar No.
particulars.description: Masked Aadhaar number (last 4 digits visible) verified against residential identity records.

particulars.title: KYC Document Re-verification
particulars.description: Officially valid KYC documents: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, DL No., and Government portal verification status/details.

particulars.title: Income
particulars.description: Substantiation of borrower and guarantor income, employment stability, and document genuineness.

particulars.title: Documents seen
particulars.description: List of verified income proofs: Salary Slips, Form 16, ITR acknowledgments, Financial Statements.

particulars.title: Pertains to year - Remarks on genuineness
particulars.description: Assessment years / periods covered and findings regarding genuineness, tax filing regularity, or employer consistency.

particulars.title: If salaried, employer name and address
particulars.description: Official employer / organization name, corporate office address, and contact coordinates.

particulars.title: Designation / Occupation - Income details - Years in occupation
particulars.description: Professional role, net monthly / annual gross income, and total continuous experience in current occupation.

particulars.title: Bank Statement
particulars.description: Re-verification of operative bank accounts, salary/business credits, and banking conduct.

particulars.title: Bank & Branch
particulars.description: Name of the banking institution and specific branch maintaining the primary operative account.

particulars.title: Type of Account
particulars.description: Account classification: Savings Bank / Current Account / Overdraft / Cash Credit.

particulars.title: Statement examined from/to
particulars.description: Start and end dates of the examined banking period (minimum 6 months) and key turnover observations.

particulars.title: Remarks on Track Record / Criminal Antecedents
particulars.description: Market feedback, local credit reputation, track record, and adverse legal/criminal database check findings.

particulars.title: Dealer & Invoice/RC Book Verification for Vehicles/Machineries
particulars.description: Collateral and asset verification for vehicle, equipment, or machinery loan applications.

particulars.title: For New Vehicles/Machineries
particulars.description: Verification details for brand new showroom vehicle or machinery procurement.

particulars.title: Dealer/Sub-dealer name/address
particulars.description: Name, address, and authorization status of supplying dealer or original equipment manufacturer.

particulars.title: Genuineness of Invoice/Advance Payment Receipts
particulars.description: Physical confirmation of invoice genuineness, quotation parity, and borrower advance margin money deposit.

particulars.title: For Old/Used Vehicles/Machineries
particulars.description: Verification details for pre-owned or secondary market vehicles and machineries.

particulars.title: Correctness of RC Book No./Machinery No.
particulars.description: Physical verification of Registration Certificate (RC), engine number, and chassis serial number against VAHAN.

particulars.title: Charge noted details in RC
particulars.description: Existing hypothecation or charge endorsement details recorded in RC book / RTO records.

particulars.title: Insurance details & validity
particulars.description: Insurance company name, policy number, coverage type (Comprehensive/Third Party), and validity expiry date.

signatories.title: Branch Use / Branch Head Scrutiny & Acceptance

footer.confidentiality_notice: Confidential Banking Document - Strictly for Internal Credit Assessment & Re-Verification Use Only

evidence_categories.title: Applicant Officially Valid KYC Documents
evidence_categories.description: Aadhaar, PAN, Driving Licence, Passport, or Voter ID copies of the primary applicant

evidence_categories.title: Guarantor / Co-Applicant KYC Documents
evidence_categories.description: Officially valid KYC identity proofs of co-applicants and guarantors

evidence_categories.title: Government Portal Verification Screenshots
evidence_categories.description: UIDAI Aadhaar validity and Income Tax e-Filing PAN-Aadhaar linking confirmation portal screenshots

evidence_categories.title: Income Proof & Substantiation Documents
evidence_categories.description: Salary slips, Form 16, ITR acknowledgment forms, audited balance sheets, or income certificates

evidence_categories.title: Bank Statements & Financial Records
evidence_categories.description: Bank account statements covering examined period, bank passbooks, or e-statements

evidence_categories.title: Residence Physical Visit & Site Inspection Evidence
evidence_categories.description: Geotagged physical residence visit photographs, site building view, and locality landmarks

evidence_categories.title: Vehicle / Machinery Proforma Invoice & Receipts
evidence_categories.description: Manufacturer/dealer quotation, proforma invoice, and advance margin money payment receipts

evidence_categories.title: Dealer / Sub-Dealer Verification Evidence
evidence_categories.description: Authorized dealership board, business premises visit photos, or GST registration confirmation

evidence_categories.title: Vehicle Registration Certificate & Hypothecation Proof
evidence_categories.description: RC book copy, Parivahan/Vahan portal screenshot, engine/chassis imprint, and insurance policy copy

evidence_categories.title: Other Relevant Field & Market Intelligence Evidence
evidence_categories.description: Neighborhood reference interview records, business board photographs, or utility bills
